answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The horizon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A raven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the orchard of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
